checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Entire image neutral B&W, no red remaining
must.why: Appears fully grayscale; car is light grey, no colour visible.

must.item: Same hatchback, same position, unchanged body details
must.why: Car shape, position, wheels, badge, lights preserved; tone is much lighter than the original red's luminance, but details intact.

must.item: Street and background retain positions and appearance apart from colour
must.why: Layout identical; slight tonal differences (brighter sky, lighter foliage) from the AI redraw, but no structural changes.

faults.what: Tonal rendering is not a straight desaturation: car appears noticeably lighter and flatter grey than the red's natural luminance, and sky and foliage are brighter and lower in contrast; the plate and tail light also look slightly different.

summary: A neutral black-and-white version with the composition, car and street preserved and no cropping; the only issue is slightly lightened, flattened tones compared with a true desaturation.
